messages:
Devon: hey team :wave: I want to lock down next-week shadowing + handoff for new on-call rotations. Marco will be shadowing as part of onboarding. Proposed bits below, please call out gaps ASAP.

Devon: proposed schedule (PST):
- Mon: Devon primary (solo)
- Tue: Devon primary morning (00:00-13:00), Marco shadowing 09:00-17:00, Tony secondary 13:00-17:00
- Wed: Tony primary, Marco available for follow-up questions
- Fri: Coverage gap 00:00-08:00 UTC (no volunteer yet)

Devon: expectations for Marco while shadowing: observe pages, sit with responder during mitigation, try runbook steps on dev cluster, and write one short postmortem draft for the test page.

Marie: sounds good. A couple notes:
- Please ensure Marco has access to PagerDuty + Slack escalation channel (cc: @Kara to confirm).
- Add Marco to the runbooks doc and give read/write to the onboarding checklist.
- For the Fri gap — I can cover part of it (02:00-05:00 UTC) but that still leaves 00:00-02:00 and 05:00-08:00 open.

Tony: I can take the Fri 05:00-08:00 UTC slot if no one else volunteers. That leaves 00:00-02:00 UTC unfilled. Might be easiest to swap a day this week if someone prefers.

Marco: thanks — quick qs: what am I allowed to ack/resolve when shadowing? can I escalate to SRE on my own?

Devon: good Q. Short rules for shadowers:
1) You may acknowledge test pages and follow the runbook steps under supervision.
2) Do not change routing rules, kill jobs, or run DB migrations without a senior present.
3) You may request an escalation to SRE or Eng on-call if the runbook indicates it, but ask the primary first.

Marie: adding links and runbook pointers — please bookmark these now:
- Handoff checklist: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/handoff-checklist
- P0 latency runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/p0-latency
- Oncall playbook (shadowing section): https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-onboarding

Marie: quick handoff checklist excerpt (paste for convenience):
```
- Open incidents: list & severity
- Mitigation state: what is currently throttled/rolled back
- PagerDuty: who is on call / escalation chain
- Known blameless notes: any ongoing change windows
- Contact list: SRE Slack, infra pager, product lead
```

Tony: also recommend a 30m pairing session Tue 08:30 PST where Marco can watch a live runthrough of the runbook and test paging flow. I'll host.

Devon: +1 to Tony. I'll create calendar invites: pairing Tue 08:30 PST, shadow Tue 09:00-17:00. Marco — expect one training alert test at 10:00 PST (simulated page). A couple practical commands you should know for the test (run in staging first):
```
# check worker queue depth
redis-cli -h staging-redis llen queue:tasks

# tail runtime logs for model server
kubectl -n inference logs -f deploy/model-server --tail=200
```

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Oncall: Shadowing test page" at 2025-06-10T10:00:00-08:00 (will post a test page to PagerDuty).

PagerDuty: Test page created by Devon — PagerDuty incident PD-TEST-184987. Please acknowledge within 5 minutes.

Devon: after the test page we'll do a short retro + micro-postmortem template (2 bullets each). Marco — you'll draft the retro and I'll review.

Kara: confirmed Marco has PagerDuty access and calendar invite. Also added a note in the onboarding doc that shadowers must complete the training checklist before being primary.

Marie: action items summary:
- Devon: create invites + test page (doing now)
- Tony: host 08:30 runthrough and take Fri 05:00-08:00 UTC if needed
- Marie: update runbook access + onboarding doc permissions
- Marco: read runbooks, complete checklist, be online Tue 08:30 for pairing

Devon: one more: if anyone can't cover the Fri gap, we'll open a short-term paid shift swap and ask all oncall engineers via DM first. Would rather not escalate to external coverage.

Tony: noted. I can be backup if someone needs to swap with me Wed->Fri.

Marco: thank you — will complete checklist tonight and post confirmation in this thread. Looking forward :eyes:

Devon: perfect. I'll post the calendar invites and drop the test page in ~5m. If you see anything missing call it out here. :thumbsup:
